body:
I was a little skeptical about this when I found it in my fridge. I googled it and saw it was for nerve pain and thought it would just be like hydrocodone. How wrong I was......
0:00 - Ate 5 of them with a pepsi... Started watching Pineapple Express.
0:30 - Everything started looking brighter and I had a slight euphoric feeling.
1:30 - Movie was over so I got up to go smoke a cigarette. Up to this point I wasn't feeling too much so when I got up and fell right back down it was a bit unexpected. After getting up and stumbling around I got to my backyard and had a cig. Felt amazing for about 30 min in my backyard then went in. Ate some food and sadly fell asleep.
Some hours later... - Tried getting up to go to school but right when I stood up I fell down instantly and fell right back to sleep. Woke back up about 5 hours later and still felt the Lyrica. Had a great time coming down for the next few hours in a euphoric stumbling around kinda way. The comedown was nice no exhaustion or anything bad just sorta camedown.
